Name: Magic Park (PIF)
Author: 7Kana
Description:
[color=#ffff00][size=5]My mods are only here on Nexus, please don't post my work elsewhere![/size][/color]
[size=4]
[/size][size=3]Ok folks, I was asked for this so I did it!
Meet Magic Park, a large PIF park that functions like a greenhouse, where if you want it will always be spring (configurable in Generic Mod Config Menu), here you can both plant and build, has a working minecart, a one-way trip boat to the beach, pool entrance to recharge energy.
In the river [size=3][size=3]you can fish:[/size][/size][size=3][size=3] sturgeon, catfish, goby, woodskip, largemouth bass, bullhead, river jelly, green algae[/size][/size].

Installation:
Unzip and paste into Stardew Valley Mods folder.

If you had the previous version installed please note that, since I had to remove the house in the tree before installing version 1.0.1 remove your items/furnish you have in there or you will lose them.
Version 1.0.2, I have made changes to the map, now you can place a door on the tree and paintings at the rock wall as shown in the pictures.

You can still have the house in the tree, thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/59821551]Kurachi84[/url]'s idea I created the little house in the tree in another mod that can be placed right on the tree in this map, you can find it here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31351]Small Room (PIF)[/url]

How do you go about getting it ingame?
You buy any door as long as it is PIF-enabled, hang it on the wall, choose the room, and go inside.
This doesn't replace the game's greenhouse nor any farm, it's a stand-alone map.
I created PIF doors that are purchased from Robin's store [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28160]here[/url]
Enjoy [color=#ff0000]<3[/color]

Remember to install the dependencies or it will not work properly.
I have tested it very little, so if you find any flaws please let me know.

[/size][color=#00ffff][size=5]Thank you all for your support! It encourages me to create and share new mods. <3[/size][/color]
